platforms.name: Google Play（含 keyboard themes / wallpaper / icon pack Apps）
platforms.source_extracted_from: 从 https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/9858738（Payments 政策页）为入口，直接访问官方 Service fees 文章
platforms.category: 手机主题/壁纸/键盘皮肤/表盘 App（第三方开发者发布）
platforms.publish_what: keyboard themes、live wallpaper、icon pack、Wear OS watch faces App 都以普通 App 形式上架，用 Play Billing 卖付费下载/IAP/订阅
platforms.revenue_share_quote: "Apps and in-app products sold through Google Play's billing system or an Alternative Billing System … in accordance with the Payments policy are subject to a service fee. There isn't a single service fee as Google Play takes into account that developers operate in different situations that require different levels of support to build sustainable businesses. 97% of developers distribute their apps and take advantage of all Google Play has to offer at no charge. Of those developers that are subject to a service fee, 99% are eligible for a fee of 15% or less by participating in different programs offered by Google Play."
platforms.revenue_share_detail_quote_old_tier: "Developers enrolled in the 15% service fee tier: 15% for the first $1M (USD) revenue earned by the developer each year; 30% for earnings in excess of $1M (USD) revenue earned by the developer each year. Subscriptions: 15% for automatically renewing subscription products purchased by subscribers, regardless of revenue earned by the developer each year"
platforms.revenue_share_detail_quote_new_2026: "For transactions with users in Australia, the European Economic Area, Japan, United Kingdom, or United States: … First $1M (USD) of annual earnings — Auto-renewing subscriptions (new & existing installs): 10% + 5% billing fee*; Other transactions (new installs): 10% + 5% billing fee*; Other transactions (existing installs): 20% + 5% billing fee*. For all remaining markets until the announced updated service fees are rolled out globally: … 15% for the first $1M (USD) … 30% for earnings in excess of $1M"
platforms.effective_dates_quote: "the regional rollout date (June 30, 2026 for the EEA, UK, and US; September 30, 2026 for Australia and Japan) serving as the effective date"
platforms.revenue_share_summary: 全球默认 15%（年收入前100万美元）+ 超100万部分30%；订阅长期 15%；2026-06-30起美英欧先切到「新装10%+5%账单费 / 老装20%+5%」，日本澳洲2026-09-30。皮肤/壁纸类多为小额一次性付费或订阅，实际落在 15%~30% 平台抽成
platforms.settlement_cycle: Google Play 按月结算（约每月15日付上月款项）——未在本页原文出现，属常识层，需以 Play Console payout 页为准（未取原文，标为待验证）
platforms.withdrawal_threshold: 未在本页给出（Play Console 需达最低付款门槛，通常 $100 附近；未取到原文，标待验证）
platforms.china_individual: 大陆个人可注册 Play Console（个人账户），但收款需银行账户/GoCardless/Payoneer 类，国内个人结汇与税务申报自担；账号需一次性 $25 注册费
platforms.risk: 🟢 官方原文；但注意 2026 新计费规则（+5% billing fee）会实打实吃掉利润
platforms.extra: 注意「20% + 5% billing fee」意味着老装用户一次性交易总抽成可达25%，对低价主题类影响显著
